verdict.rationale: Runpod's own security-and-compliance reference documents several parts of the story. Secure Cloud runs on vetted partners holding SOC 2, ISO 27001 and PCI DSS certifications, in T3/T4 data centers, and multi-tenant workloads use containerized isolation to keep other users from accessing data. However, the SOC 2 claim describes the infrastructure partners rather than Runpod itself, and the data-handling coverage is only a single isolation statement. Missing for 10: Runpod's own SOC 2 attestation or a way to obtain reports (trust center), detailed data-handling/retention/encryption policies, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can verify the provider's security and compliance posture (SOC 2, data handling, datacenter tiers) before putting proprietary models on it

citations.quote: Secure Cloud provides vetted infrastructure partners who meet enterprise security standards including SOC 2, ISO 27001, and PCI DSS certifications.
Secure Cloud: Operates in T3/T4 data centers, providing high reliability and security for enterprise and production workloads.
Your Pods and workers run in a multi-tenant environment with containerized isolation that prevents other users from accessing your data.
